mainEntity.name: What should I do first if I want to run a one-person business with AI but have no idea where to start?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start with one recurring business problem, not a collection of tools. For Run My AI Biz readers, a practical first project might be turning customer research into a reviewed newsletter outline, lead magnet, or sales-page draft. AI can speed research and first drafts, but you remain responsible for the offer, facts, audience fit, and final decisions. Choose a workflow that occurs often enough to measure, write down its inputs and desired output, and define where approval is required. A focused starting point usually creates less confusion than attempting to build a complete automated business immediately. Run My AI Biz’s educational approach is useful for comparing workflows before committing to a larger system.
acceptedAnswer.description: Pick one repeated task—such as research, newsletter drafting, lead-magnet creation, or follow-up—and build a simple reviewed workflow around it. Define the input, expected output, approval point, and success measure before adding more tools.
